summary: Aptos BTC-focused lending, strategy and liquid-staking protocol that announced an orderly wind-down on October 19, 2026, immediately closing new borrowing, deposits and staking while retaining temporary user exit routes.
what_happened: Reports reproducing Echo Protocol's October 19 notice say that new lending deposits and borrowing, new strategy deposits, and new liquid staking stopped. Borrowers were directed to repay by November 14; remaining users were told to withdraw, repay or unstake by November 19 at 23:59 UTC. Liquidation and settlement may continue thereafter; an Aptos-to-B² aBTC redemption bridge is expected to remain available.
uncertainty_notes: No permanent independently retrievable Echo official notice URL was obtained during this review; the cited reports reproduce or paraphrase the operator's announcement. Do not infer a completed November shutdown, completed withdrawal, insolvency, or loss outcome. Echo Protocol is distinct from Echo.xyz; prior Monad incident is not established as the cause of this wind-down.
notes: Canonical record is for Echo Protocol's yield/lending products, not a generalized declaration that its Aptos-to-B² bridge is closed.
